briefs.title: The Weight of It All
briefs.hook: I'm carrying 30kg, but the weight I'm hiding is worse
briefs.audience: People in their 20s-40s who want to get outdoors, look after their health, and say yes to more
briefs.core_message: The weighted vest is not just physical, but also mental
briefs.beginning: I thought I was just toughening up, but the truth is, I've been struggling
briefs.middle: The weight I'm carrying is not just 30kg, it's the weight of my secrets
briefs.end: Now I'm facing my demons, one summit at a time
briefs.voiceover: I was struggling to breathe, and I couldn't tell anyone, but the weight of the vest was a silent killer. It's made me question my limits, but also face my fears. It's time to confront the weight I've been hiding
briefs.caption: Sponsor my summit and help me carry the weight of mental health. movember.com/m/15440871

briefs.title: Fear of the Punch
briefs.hook: My biggest fear, and how it almost stopped me

briefs.middle: But the weighted vest has been my secret training partner, pushing me to face my fears head-on and build up my confidence.
briefs.end: Now, I'm ready to step into the ring and take on whatever comes my way. Bring it on!
